test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 9 Mar 2021 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Which of the following is NOT correct in the context of PSUs and their year of establishment?

options.text: Oil and Natural Gas Corporation in 1956

solution:
The correct answer is __**Damodar Valley Corporation in 1958**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• The Damodar Valley Corporation (DVC) was established in 1948, not in 1958, making option 3 incorrect.
 
• DVC is one of the oldest multipurpose river valley projects in India and it operates in the Damodar River area.
 
• The corporation manages activities related to flood control, irrigation, and power generation.
 
• DVC has played a critical role in the development of the states of West Bengal and Jharkhand.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Oil and Natural Gas Corporation (ONGC)**

 
 
• ONGC was established on 14th August 1956.
 
• It is a multinational crude oil and gas corporation and is the largest oil and gas exploration and production company in India.
 
• ONGC operates under the administrative control of the Ministry of Petroleum and Natural Gas.
 
• It contributes around 70% to India’s domestic production of crude oil.
 
 
 
• **Airports Authority of India (AAI)**
 
 
• AAI was constituted by an Act of Parliament and came into existence on 1st April 1995.
 
• It is responsible for creating, upgrading, maintaining, and managing civil aviation infrastructure in India.
 
• AAI manages a total of 125 airports, including 11 international airports.
 
• It also provides Air Traffic Management (ATM) services over Indian airspace and adjoining oceanic areas.
 
 
 
• **Balmer Lawrie & Co. Ltd.**
 
 
• Balmer Lawrie was established in 1867.
 
• It is a public sector company under the Ministry of Petroleum & Natural Gas.
 
• The company operates in various business segments such as Industrial Packaging, Logistics, and Travel & Vacations.
 
• Balmer Lawrie is known for its high ethical standards and governance practices.
